text:
jess: Quick sync — dedicated capacity buildout update. PO for 12x H100 nodes is showing a 3-day delay (procurement says vendor backorder). Need clarity on: rack availability, network egress rules for the private cluster, and who owns the reservation in the console.

marco: Thanks — we're tracking. PO#: PO-87421 (procurement_bot just echoed). New ETA vendor-side is Fri 03/22. Rack space at DC-East has 2U left; we'll need to rearrange to fit 6U.

procurement_bot: PO-87421 status: "Confirmed, awaiting fulfillment". Carrier: AtlasLogix. Tracking pending. Contact: vendor.ops@atlaslogix.example.

rachel: From product: Customer pilot needs guaranteed 8x GPUs by 03/29. Can we meet that if vendor slips?

jess: If vendor holds to Fri 03/22 we should be fine for 8x by 03/27 after racking + burn-in. Plan B: swap 4 H100s for 8x A800s temporarily. Need ML signoff.

lina: A800s are fine for initial perf work but will affect peak perf on large context evals. We can run comparative perf tests in the staging cluster. I can own the perf validation (samples + latency checks).

samir: Cabling & power crew booked Tue 03/26 AM for full racking + PDUs. If parts arrive earlier we can accelerate. Need network VLANs prepped — who configures?

marco: @network-team (cc'ing here) — can we get VLAN + firewall rules for 10.240.5.0/24 by Mon 03/25? Also will add routing for isolated VPC peering to the private control plane.

jess: I'll own console reservation. I'll create a Dedicated reservation ticket and assign to @marco for cluster setup.

marco: Noted. Action items: 1) Procurement confirm shipping ETA (procurement_bot) 2) Rack rearrange plan (marco) 3) VLAN + firewall (network) 4) Perf validation (lina) 5) Console reservation + quotas (jess)

rachel: Can we surface a simple timeline in the ticket: "Arrive -> Rack -> Network -> Burn-in -> Reserve -> Pilot" with owners? Customer wants dates.

jess: Will add timeline to ticket. Rough forecast now: Arrive Fri 03/22 -> Rack Tue 03/26 -> Network Wed 03/27 -> Burn-in Thu-Fri 03/28-03/29 -> Reservation live Mon 03/31. Contingency: if vendor slips > 3 days, swap-in A800s for pilot.

procurement_bot: Update: Carrier manifest created. ETA now 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.

samir: FYI burn-in needs temp power headroom. Ops will throttle noncritical loads on the rack during warmup — flagged.

lina: I'll prep perf scripts and a quick eval checklist (latency, throughput, opa tests).

marco: One more dependency — firmware image for NICs needs the newer driver (v2.4.1). If firmware update is required, plan adds ~2 hours to burn-in.

jess: Good catch. Add firmware step to burn-in and mark as owner: marco.

rachel: Thanks team. If anything slips past Wed please call out so we can set customer expectations.

jess: Agreed — I'll post updates here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
